description: Election Commission - Declare that Mr. H. A. K. Somaweera as a member of the Matara Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy for a Member of the Matara Municipal Council due to a resignation. The content specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority, including the nomination of a new member by a political party and the formal declaration by the Returning Officer. This falls under the Elections category (Type 7) as it involves electoral processes and declarations related to local government elections.
